config.alert_time: visible time = information time + provider delay
config.alert_unit_definition: only the first row of an asset-session where the final rule mask is on; later re-entries (NONE -> WATCH again) produce no new true positive, do not clear an earlier false alert and do not add recall
config.change_policy: immutable; any change to the label definition requires a new LABEL VERSION and a new manifest
config.event_peak: start time of swing high bar (earliest instant the high can have printed)
config.event_start: start time of swing low bar
config.first_observation: end of first session bar (first bar start + 5 min)
config.fpr_definition: non-event sessions (no qualifying swing) with an alert / non-event sessions
config.lead_definition: (entry - event_low) / (event_high - event_low) on the matched swing; entry = open of first bar starting at/after visible time; clipped to [0, 1] for safety only
config.matching: chronological one-to-one: the primary first alert can match only the event window that contains it (earliest unmatched); one alert never catches two events; other events of the session stay missed in the primary metric. Sensitivity: each activation in time order matches the earliest unmatched event whose window contains it; further activations in a matched window are IN_EVENT_DUPLICATE
config.opening_gap_policy: session open / previous session close - 1 >= event_threshold -> OPENING_GAP_EVENT session flag; separate class, never an intraday event, never in intraday denominators
config.post_peak_policy: alert outside every event window with no later event in the session -> POST_PEAK_ALERT; never a true positive
config.pre_event_alert_policy: alert outside every event window and before the start of a later event in the same session -> PRE_EVENT_ALERT; never a true positive
config.precision_definition: primary: asset-sessions whose first alert is IN_EVENT / alerted asset-sessions (sensitivity: IN_EVENT activations incl. duplicates / all activations)
config.sensitivity_alert_unit_definition: rising edge of the final rule mask within an asset-session (first row, or row whose previous row in the same session was not alerting); diagnostic only, never a primary metric
config.swing_definition: runup(j) = High[j] / min(Low[a..j]) - 1 within a bar range [a..b]; swing peak bar j = first argmax of runup; swing low bar i = first bar in [a..j] attaining that minimum Low
config.swing_policy: RECURSIVE_LARGEST_FIRST: largest swing of the session is primary (equals V1 max_runup); repeat on bars before its low bar and after its peak bar; every disjoint swing with runup >= event_threshold is an event
config.timestamps: market bar start times (Europe/Istanbul); provider-delay independent
